record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.context_brief: Finiteness of closed diagonal orbits in compact sets
record.original_question: For every compact set K in SL(3,R)/SL(3,Z), are there only finitely many closed A-orbits contained in K, where A is the full diagonal group in SL(3,R)?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 40 (G. Margulis). For every compact set K of SL(3, R)/SL(3, Z), there are only ﬁnitely many closed A-orbits contained in K .

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $G=\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{R})$, let $\Gamma=\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{Z})$, and consider the homogeneous space $X=G/\Gamma$ equipped with the quotient topology. Let $A\subset G$ denote the full diagonal subgroup, i.e. the subgroup of diagonal matrices with positive entries and determinant $1$ (a connected abelian subgroup isomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^2$). For a point $x\in X$, the orbit $Ax\subset X$ is called closed if it is a closed subset of $X$. Prove or disprove the following statement: for every compact subset $K\subset X$, there are only finitely many closed $A$-orbits in $X$ that are entirely contained in $K$.
artifact.status_search_result: This is a well-known conjecture of Margulis about closed orbits of the full diagonal Cartan subgroup on SL(3,R)/SL(3,Z). It remains open: it is discussed in surveys of open problems in homogeneous dynamics and is closely tied to Littlewood's conjecture and to rigidity of higher-rank diagonal actions. Partial results (e.g., on bounded orbits, exceptional orbits via Schmidt games, and nonhomogeneous orbit closures) exist but do not resolve the finiteness statement.

status_evidence.title: A nonhomogeneous orbit closure of a diagonal subgroup
status_evidence.snippet: Studies orbit closures of the diagonal subgroup A on SL(3,R)/SL(3,Z), in the context of Margulis-type conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Closed A-orbit structure on SL(3,R)/SL(3,Z) remains an active research topic with only partial results.

status_evidence.title: Bounded Orbits of Diagonalizable Flows on SL3(R)/SL3(Z)
status_evidence.snippet: Considers bounded orbits of diagonal flows on SL(3,R)/SL(3,Z).
status_evidence.claim: Research on bounded/closed A-orbits in this space is ongoing; Margulis's finiteness conjecture has not been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Modified Schmidt games and a conjecture of Margulis
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a Margulis conjecture about abundance of exceptional orbits of partially hyperbolic flows using Schmidt games.
status_evidence.claim: Related Margulis conjectures have been addressed, but the finiteness conjecture for closed A-orbits in compacts remains open.
